kind: model validation on the whole published suite, not a proof
not_covered: cycle-level behaviour: the vectors' bus cycles are not checked, the model has no cycle granularity
the 12 JAM encodings (halt; nothing to compare)
interrupt and reset entry (no vectors exist; unit-tested in formal/tests/test_model_full.py)
NESMemory's region map (these vectors assume a flat 64 KiB)

per_opcode.name: 0x02 JAM imp
per_opcode.note: halts the processor; the vectors record the bus activity of a jammed CPU, not an instruction outcome.  Not compared.

what_the_vectors_record.divergence: the vectors leave PC one past the opcode and the model leaves it at the opcode; the model also sets `halted`, after which it performs no further fetch, so PC is dead state.  This is why JAM is reported apart and never counted as agreement.
